chunks: But We saved him and his family, except for his wife who was one of those who stayed behind.

key_terms.الْغَابِرِينَ: Those who stayed behind or perished

ai.seo_question: Who was Prophet Noah's wife and why did she not survive the flood?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'among those who stayed behind' (al-ghabirun) is interpreted to mean that Nuh's wife was not necessarily killed in the flood but remained on the ark or the earth, excluded from salvation due to her persistent disbelief despite being married to a prophet. This highlights the distinction between marital proximity and spiritual merit, a key theme in understanding the fate of the 'people of the house' in various prophetic narratives.
